Maya Iyer: Seeing a billing delta for two accounts in the 02:00-02:10 UTC window. Billed > logs. Can eng take a quick look?
Liam Chen: which accounts?
Maya Iyer: PixelForge and ClearScale. Invoices 2025-12-05-PF and 2025-12-05-CS.
Samir Patel: I'll grep logs. Any recent deploys around 02:00?
Liam Chen: we deployed routing-fix v2.4.1 at 01:58 UTC. Small change to streaming finalize emitter.
billing-bot: [automated] billing-runner job 2025-12-05 flagged unusual ingress vs billable delta for 02:00-02:15
Alex Gomez: quick theory: finalize event emitted twice for short-lived streams after the router change. Could lead to duplicate billable token events.
Priya Rao: if we get counts, I can estimate dollar impact. Threshold: auto-credit if < $500.
Liam Chen: pulled counts: PixelForge billed_tokens=1,045,200, unique_tokens=972,600, delta=72,600. ClearScale billed=2,120,800, unique=2,048,900, delta=71,900.
Priya Rao: PixelForge delta -> mix gen+embed -> est $65.17. ClearScale est $64.54. Both under $500.
Maya Iyer: finance: hold final posting until backfill run. Actions: (1) Liam upload CSV, (2) Alex patch emitter to dedupe, (3) Priya draft credits, (4) support note.
Liam Chen: CSV uploaded: /shared/finance/reconciliations/1773001234-window-delta.csv (cols: customer, billed_tokens, unique_tokens, delta_tokens)
Alex Gomez: pushed hotfix to canary to ensure finalize idempotency. Will roll to prod after smoke test.
Priya Rao: credit memos drafted and attached to CSV. Amounts small so auto-credit per policy.
Maya Iyer: Support please send templated note referencing "transient double-finalize emission; adjustment issued".
billing-bot: [automated] billing-runner job 2025-12-05 completed with warnings: duplicate_finalize_events detected
Maya Iyer: thanks team. Close after backfill applied and notes sent. :white_check_mark:
